mapper.select: SELECT attempt_id, delivery_id, provider_id, provider_request_no, provider_message_id, status, response_code, resolution_source, resolution_code, started_time, finished_time, resolved_time, create_time, update_time FROM t_notification_attempt WHERE attempt_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notification_attempt (attempt_id, delivery_id, provider_id, provider_request_no, provider_message_id, status, response_code, resolution_source, resolution_code, started_time, finished_time, resolved_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{attemptId}, #{deliveryId}, #{providerId}, #{providerRequestNo}, #{providerMessageId}, #{status}, #{responseCode}, #{resolutionSource}, #{resolutionCode}, #{startedTime}, #{finishedTime}, #{resolvedTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT attempt_id, delivery_id, provider_id, provider_request_no, provider_message_id, status, response_code, resolution_source, resolution_code, started_time, finished_time, resolved_time, create_time, update_time FROM t_notification_attempt WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND status != 'FAILED' LIMIT 2
